backup.sundayFailed.title: Backup failed: Sunday's snapshot wasn't added to the sync folder
backup.sundayFailed.body: The snapshot from {date} (Sunday) didn't make it into the sync folder at the time, and this retry failed too: {reason}.
backup.localFailed.title: Backup failed: couldn't take the local snapshot
backup.localFailed.body: The backup at {when} failed: {reason}. The sync folder wasn't updated either.
backup.syncFailed.title: Backup failed: couldn't write to the sync folder
backup.syncFailed.body: Backup at {when}: the local snapshot is done ({date} in the local backup area), but it wasn't written to the sync folder: {reason}.
backup.checkFailed.title: Snapshot check failed: {date} in {place}
backup.checkFailed.body: Weekly check: the latest snapshot in {place} ({date}) failed the integrity check: {problems}{more}. The next backup will take a fresh snapshot; avoid this one if you need to restore.
backup.syncDir.placeholder: The sync folder in the config is still the example placeholder ({dir}); change it to a real sync folder on this computer
backup.owner.unknown: unknown owner (the lock file isn't fully written yet)
backup.busy: another backup ({owner}) still hadn't finished after 2 hours, so this one was skipped
backup.overdue.body_one: Backups are left to an external timer (backup.schedule is external). The last one was at {last}, and nothing has run for {n} day since. Check whether the scheduled task that runs npm run backup every day was paused or deleted, or tap “Back up now” to take one right away.
backup.overdue.body_other: Backups are left to an external timer (backup.schedule is external). The last one was at {last}, and nothing has run for {n} days since. Check whether the scheduled task that runs npm run backup every day was paused or deleted, or tap “Back up now” to take one right away.
backup.overdue.neverBody_one: Backups are left to an external timer (backup.schedule is external), and none has run in the {n} day since {since}. Check that the scheduled task that runs npm run backup every day exists and isn't paused, or tap “Back up now” to take one right away.
backup.overdue.neverBody_other: Backups are left to an external timer (backup.schedule is external), and none has run in the {n} days since {since}. Check that the scheduled task that runs npm run backup every day exists and isn't paused, or tap “Back up now” to take one right away.
